article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- — Pjay Smith Jr. scored 32 points as Furman beat Samford 80-72 on Wednesday night. Smith added four steals for the Paladins (20-8, 8-7 Southern Conference). Cooper Bowser scored 16 points and added six rebounds. Nick Anderson had 13 points and went 4 of 10 from the field (3 for 8 from 3-point range). Jaden Brownell led the Bulldogs (20-8, 10-5) in scoring, finishing with 25 points, two steals and two blocks. Josh Holloway and Trey Fort each recorded 14 points. Both teams play again on Saturday.
